# The legacy engine (pygeovision.ai)

`pygeovision.ai` is the first implementation, kept because the command line and some pipelines still use parts of it.
New code should prefer the packages on the other pages. [Architecture](../../architecture.md#systems-that-exist-twice)
explains which concepts exist twice and why.

**Explained in:** [Architecture](../../architecture.md) · [How the registries relate](../../models/registry.md)

This page documents **88 public classes and functions** in 31 modules.

## `pygeovision.ai.training.losses`

Loss functions for geospatial AI training.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `DiceLoss` | class | Soft Dice loss for binary and multi-class segmentation. |
| `FocalLoss` | class | Focal loss for addressing extreme class imbalance. |
